remarks: Situated on a LARGE corner lot, this spacious El Monte home offers 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, with 2,373 square feet of versatile living space. The generous floor plan features an expansive kitchen and dining area, an inviting family room, and a spacious primary suite with a walk-in closet and well-appointed bathroom. A dedicated office and flexible bonus room provide additional space for a home gym, playroom, or hobby room. Set on an expansive 9,751 square-foot lot, the outdoor space is designed for privacy and enjoyment, featuring a sparkling pool, fully gated front yard, private backyard enclosed by concrete block walls, and convenient RV parking.
